target.title: fix: reduce redundant apply continuation runs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

ClawSweeper apply runs can currently create noisy continuation traffic when one default cursor-based apply lane is already queued or running for the same target repo. That makes the Actions queue harder to read and can mask the real apply-health problems we want maintainers to notice.

This is the workflow-noise follow-up from the post-#375 improvement list.

## Why This Change Was Made

This PR keeps explicit/manual apply continuations exact, but lets default cursor-based continuation runs share an already-active same-target apply run.

Changes:

- Adds target-specific Actions run titles for apply and comment-sync lanes, including the ClawHub schedule.
- Checks active/queued/requested/waiting/in-progress `ClawSweeper` runs before dispatching another default cursor apply continuation.
- Only suppresses dispatch when the continuation is the default auto-selected cursor lane; explicit item lists and non-default inputs still dispatch with their exact values.
- De-dupes paginated Actions results, ignores the current run, and ignores queued runs that have been stale for more than six hours.
- Documents the behavior in `docs/scheduler.md`.
- Extends workflow tests so the guard covers the exact title, pagination, explicit-input preservation, and heredoc indentation.

## User Impact

Maintainers should see fewer duplicate apply continuation runs for the same repository, while still getting a clear continuation path via the already-running lane or the existing schedule fallback. Manual targeted sweeps remain unaffected.

## Evidence

Local proof from `C:\oc-work\clawsweeper-workflow-noise` at head `e0bfb45492ee88b9a3d6a117c822543b4fe2c559`:

```text
node --test test\sweep-workflow.test.ts
# 34 passing, 1 skipped

pnpm run format:check
# passed

pnpm run check:active-surface
# passed

$env:PNPM_BIN='C:\Users\marti\AppData\Local\Corepack\shims\pnpm.cmd'; pnpm run check
# 1134 passing, 1 skipped, 0 failing, 100% coverage, format clean
```

`PNPM_BIN` is set on Windows so target-validation spawns the `.cmd` shim; CI Linux should not need that override.

Codex review proof:

```text
codex review -c service_tier='fast' --uncommitted
# final pass: no actionable correctness issues found
```

Earlier Codex review findings were fixed before this PR was opened:

- Preserve explicit/non-default apply continuation inputs.
- Paginate the active-run lookup.
- Fix the workflow heredoc terminator indentation.
- Include `APPLY_COMMENT_SYNC_MIN_AGE_DAYS` in the shareability predicate.

No live apply, close, label, merge, or repair mutation was run.

## Screenshots / Visual Proof

Not applicable for this item: it is workflow/log behavior rather than dashboard UI. The visible change is the Actions run title, for example `Apply ClawSweeper closures for openclaw/openclaw`, plus a log line when an existing same-target run covers the continuation.

## Dependency / Stack Note

Please land #391 first. Until #391 lands, GitHub may show the #391 dashboard commits in this PR diff. This PR itself is the workflow-noise continuation cleanup on top of that base.

## Risk

Low to moderate workflow risk. The suppression path is intentionally narrow and only applies to default cursor-based apply continuations. If the active-run lookup fails or no matching active run exists, the workflow keeps the existing dispatch behavior and the scheduled apply cadence remains the fallback.
